messages:
lina: fyi seeing bad LCP spikes on console canary ~11:14 — main thread GC pauses ~200-400ms repeatedly when opening heavy dashboards. timeline shows a big chunk labeled 'source map parse' during initial paint.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 1747199800 finished (jamie) :white_check_mark:

alex: can you paste the trace snippet or a flame so we can see where the time goes?

lina: pasted small trace and perf link: https://perf.redwood/profiles/1747200000 — relevant flame: main -> parseSourceMap -> parseMappings (~300ms) and then GC. attaching stack snippet:

```
MainThread
  parseBundle (bundle.js:1)
  parseSourceMap (bundle.js.map)
  compileMappings (sourcemap-parser)
  MajorGC
```

jamie: we pushed the bundle change in 1.17.2 earlier — bundler flagged some large vendor maps to be inlined to simplify CDN invalidation. looks like inlining moved a 620kb map into the main payload.

mike: yeah i touched the build: switched to inline for last-deploy to avoid a flaky map upload step. i didn't think about parse cost on client. sorry — my bad.

alex: chrome still does a lot of sourcemap parsing on the main thread for big maps. >500kb inlined maps are basically guaranteed to hit main-thread parse and cause jank.

lina: telemetry also appears to eagerly init mapping code during dashboard boot (telemetry.init -> map.apply). that amplifies the problem on first paint.

jamie: quick mitigation options: rollback the canary or strip inlined maps from prod bundles and re-deploy. can do a targeted rollback for the bundler change.

mike: i can open a hotfix PR to stop inlining maps > 200kb and revert the bundler flag. will also add a guard so CI fails if an inlined map > 250kb makes it into client bundles.

alex: longer term: two proposals — 1) ensure sourcemap parsing happens in a worker (if browser supports off-main-thread parse), or 2) ship external .map files and change telemetry to lazy-load and map only when user opens dev panels. also add a bundler rule: no inlined maps for third-party libs.

lina: +1. for immediate next steps: mike rolls back canary and opens hotfix PR; jamie to coordinate canary rollback with eng-sre; i'll add a dashboard perf alert (main-thread GC > 150ms spike) and a tiny repro suite to catch regressions.

jamie: pinging @eng-sre for rollback window and monitoring plan. also filing issue https://redwood/issue/PR-4098 to track CI check and worker-parsing spike investigation.

mike: hotfix PR #4099 opened — stops inlining, adds CI check, and a short note in release notes. scheduling immediate rollback.

lina: thanks — after rollback i'll run acanary perf comparison and share numbers. trying to avoid a full revert if we can patch quickly. :pray:

alex: one last ask — add a build-time warning in the bundler when total inlined map size across all chunks exceeds 300kb. it's an easy safeguard.

lina: noted. i added it to the tracking issue. will follow up once rollback is done and we have a perf diff.
